verdict.rationale: Ollama's local-first design ('nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine') effectively lets a user keep data on their own device/region by choosing local execution, and prompts are 'never tracked or trained on'. However there's no evidence of an explicit region/residency selection feature (e.g., choosing a specific data-center region) for Ollama Cloud usage. Missing for 10: explicit cloud region/residency options, data center location controls, compliance documentation (GDPR/data residency certifications).
